PDF Empty Space Skipping and Occlusion Clipping for Texture-based Volume ...
Empty space skipping that skips empty voxels and early ray termination that skips occluded voxels, have been successfully applied in software-based volume rendering while there is little effort in exploiting them in texture-based approaches.
